PaveBench: A Versatile Benchmark for Pavement Distress Perception and Interactive Vision-Language Analysis












	
		
	
	
		Abstract
	

PaveBench is a large-scale benchmark for pavement distress perception and interactive vision-language analysis on real-world highway inspection images. It supports four core tasks: classification, object detection, semantic segmentation, and vision-language question answering.
